description: This file sets up a Streamlit-based web app that integrates with various language models and SQL databases to create a conversational SQL chatbot. It includes environment configuration, database connection, language model setup, and a user interface for querying the database with responses managed via a token counting function.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a language model chain, and returns the result while tracking token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that initializes the Streamlit app, manages chat history, and processes user queries by invoking the count_tokens function.
